# Webflow Site Data API

`webflow-data-api` · openapi · version `2.0.0` · **published** · readiness `reviewed_publication_user_test_required`

Webflow Data API operations available to site API tokens, scoped by Webflow to the token's single site. Authorization, Custom Code, Workspace Activity, and workspace site creation are excluded. Additional operations require their own site-token scopes.
